reference.title: Lung explant reference gallery (LAM, UIP, PLCH & CLAD)
reference.intro: Open-licence photomicrographs and key diagnostic discriminators for lymphangioleiomyomatosis, UIP/IPF, PLCH, pulmonary hypertension and CLAD.

groups.heading: Lymphangioleiomyomatosis (LAM)
points: Diffuse thin-walled parenchymal cysts throughout all lobes with nodular/fascicular proliferations of immature spindle-to-epithelioid smooth muscle-like (LAM) cells in cyst walls, lymphatics and vessels
Positive for HMB-45 (patchy/focal), SMA, Cathepsin K, ER and PR; frequently accompanied by haemosiderin-laden macrophages

images.caption: Lymphangioleiomyomatosis — spindle-to-epithelioid smooth muscle-like LAM cells lining thin-walled cystic spaces (H&E, high mag).

groups.heading: Usual interstitial pneumonia (UIP / IPF)
points: Spatial and temporal heterogeneity: patchy subpleural/paraseptal dense collagenous fibrosis alternating with spared lung, microscopic honeycombing (bronchiolar epithelium-lined cysts) and fibroblastic foci at the leading edge
Exclude airway-centred fibrosis / granulomas (fibrotic HP) and prominent lymphoid follicles / pleuritis (CTD-ILD)

images.caption: UIP — honeycomb fibrosis with remodeled airspaces lined by respiratory epithelium separated by dense fibrous bands (H&E).

groups.heading: Pulmonary Langerhans cell histiocytosis (PLCH)
points: Upper-lobe predominant bronchiolocentric stellate fibrotic nodules and irregular cysts in smokers
Clusters of Langerhans cells with coffee-bean grooved nuclei and admixed eosinophils; confirm with CD1a and Langerin (CD207)

images.caption: Pulmonary Langerhans cell histiocytosis — Langerhans cells with grooved nuclei and admixed eosinophils (H&E, high mag).

groups.heading: CLAD (BOS vs RAS) & Pulmonary Hypertension (criteria)
points: CLAD-BOS: constrictive / obliterative bronchiolitis — concentric subepithelial fibrosis narrowing or completely obliterating membranous and respiratory bronchioles (use EVG/trichrome to spot obliterated airways)
CLAD-RAS: pleuroparenchymal fibroelastosis (PPFE) / alveolar fibroelastosis filling subpleural alveoli, often coexisting with obliterative bronchiolitis
PAH (Heath–Edwards): medial hypertrophy, concentric laminar intimal fibrosis and plexiform/dilatation lesions of muscular pulmonary arteries

snippets.label: LAM TSC / genetics note
snippets.text: Lymphangioleiomyomatosis (LAM) may occur sporadically or in association with tuberous sclerosis complex (TSC1/TSC2); clinical correlation for renal angiomyolipomas and TSC evaluation is recommended.

snippets.label: CLAD ISHLT clinical correlation
snippets.text: Correlation with pre-retransplant pulmonary function tests, HRCT findings and donor-specific HLA antibodies (DSA) is recommended in accordance with the ISHLT CLAD consensus.

snippets.label: Incidental lung carcinoma synoptic reminder
snippets.text: An incidental primary lung carcinoma is identified; formal synoptic staging should be completed using the Lung carcinoma resection template.
